claims.claim: Compact classical evidence trades storage against speed and global localisation coverage.
Existing refiners require a more careful failure hypothesis, not an attention-based success claim.
The studies proved that our medical images suffer clinically significant diagnostic disruption from watermark embedding.
claims.reason: Current compact validation is nonembedding; classifier and embedding-specific medical results are pending.

claims.claim: Diagnostic-constrained embedding is a new medical-watermarking idea.
claims.reason: PFF-WM uses diagnostic saliency/explanation alignment; MedSign already uses pathology-aware embedding preservation.

claims.claim: A payload-preserving quantized correction mechanism is implemented with controlled baselines.
Reducing guide-model KL establishes diagnostic preservation or transfer.
claims.reason: Explicit toy counterexample improves guide KL while worsening unseen-model KL; random control can tie the guide result.

claims.claim: Our study motivated testing diagnostic-constrained embedding under fixed payload constraints.
The candidate is SOTA-superior or clinically safe.

prior_art.title: Explainable and proactive fragile watermarking for medical Deepfake detection
prior_art.verified_overlap: Diagnostic saliency guides embedding; frozen-classifier Grad-CAM alignment loss in explainability.

prior_art.title: Pathology-Aware Adaptive Watermarking for Text-Driven Medical Image Synthesis (MedSign)
prior_art.verified_overlap: Primary abstract/introduction: pathology localization maps adapt watermark strength and preserve critical regions during diffusion-decoder fine-tuning.

next_required_evidence: Reviewed diagnostic classifier with adequate reported class-wise performance, no automatic approval.
